# Complete derived method-record table - r0.4

Complete sole current Stage B review-candidate normative core: SCI-FRUIT-NORMATIVE-CORE v0.1/r0.4. Canonical source-inventory SHA-256: `3dc912d9f6a58d9f92561ad10b9442485c5b47232e5327389d2fb3b89c296e92`. Owner approval, freeze, Registry registration and activation are not established. Numerical methods/routes remain unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval.

Every method-specific instance must supply all twenty-one binding classes and the full current core's obligations, with exact owner/upstream numerical authority. FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD is a required-record family only. The historical column records the admitted comparison basis; it supplies no hidden obligation or selected numerical value. Current complete definitions and REQ-023 govern.
